MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for Default Prove-Up Hearing this day.
Dept. 218, Commissioner: Sue Kaplan, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: P. VanSteenberge.
Philip Keith, Esq. for Plaintiff: Poett LLC, a limited liability company.
Plaintiff's Witness: Gerald K. Dowd, was sworn and direct examined.
After hearing the evidence presented, the Court rules in favor of the Plaintiff and against the Defaulted Defendants: Calvin Turner and Mary Sullivan as follows:
Judgment for immediate possession of the premises located at 1961 Sutter St., #1, San Francisco, CA. 94115.
Judgment signed in open court.
